questions.stem: What is the role of cryolite in the extraction of aluminium?

options.text: It acts as the reducing agent for aluminium oxide
It provides extra aluminium ions for the electrolysis
It lowers the melting point of aluminium oxide, reducing energy costs
It prevents the carbon anodes from burning away

questions.explanation: Cryolite (Na₃AlF₆) is used to dissolve aluminium oxide and lower its melting point from about 2050 degrees C to about 950 degrees C. This significantly reduces the amount of energy needed and makes the process more economical.
